newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly slip $1 but gas oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly slip $1 but gas oil steady.

text.p: NWE oil products mostly eased $1 a tonne early on Monday but gas oil stayed flat.
Gasoline traded at $204.50 fob ARA soon after the open compared to talk nearer $205.50 on Friday. Swaps talked $207 for June swaps and $200.50 for July.
Gas oil was little changed with premiums holding at $1.50 a tonne and $1 over the June IPE for prompt and late June loading barges. June IPE was unchanged at $172.50 at 0925 GMT.
Heavy fuel slipped $1 a tonne amid growing Russian supplies although no early trade was heard. Dealers saw several sellers at $82.50 but only modest demand at $81 fob for barges.
